quantity-aware-retrieval

Quantity-aware Retrieval

Retrieve clinical passages that satisfy numerical conditions, using supplied examples and a local embedding model.

Domain
clinical passage retrieval
Primary focus
Quantity-sensitive semantic retrieval
Primary metric
Baseline-normalized mean nDCG@10
numerical constraintssearch-swe
On this page
OverviewRuntime and requirementsPublic input and output contractInputsOutputsEvaluation

Runtime and requirements

  • Agent budget: 6 hours
  • Compute: 16 CPUs, 32 GiB RAM, 100 GiB storage; one A100 40 GB GPU
  • Build limit: 1,200 seconds
  • Query limit: 5 seconds per question, evaluated sequentially

Use only the supplied data/model and documented optional OpenRouter/Jina resources. Additional datasets, weights and external answer lookup are prohibited. The query limit includes startup, inference, API work and output writing.

Public input and output contract

Inputs

  • /task/data/corpus.jsonl — 153,252 MedQuant passages.
  • /task/data/examples.jsonl — 80,000 examples spanning 12,453 distinct query texts.
  • /task/models/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B — the supplied local embedding model.

The examples contain synthetically edited passage text; they are not corpus-ID relevance judgments. There is no public retrieval validation split. The verifier withholds training examples and evaluates 210 original queries.

Outputs

Submit executable scripts and dependencies under /app:

/app/build.sh --corpus /task/data/corpus.jsonl --index-dir /app/index
/app/run.sh --index-dir /app/index --queries /path/to/queries.jsonl --output /path/to/results.jsonl --top-k 10

The verifier rebuilds once, then runs each query separately as an unprivileged user with read-only submission code. Put writable runtime state in the supplied index directory; build may initialize a persistent service.

{"query_id":"example","results":[{"doc_id":"document-id","score":0.123}]}

Return zero to ten distinct known IDs with finite descending scores and ties in corpus order. Empty results are valid and score zero.

Evaluation

Let Q be mean binary nDCG@10 over all 210 questions. Use the specified reference constant exactly as given:

B = 0.3174
reward = clamp((Q - B) / (1 - B), 0, 1)

The rounded constant 0.3174 is the contract's baseline; do not substitute an unrounded historical measurement. There is no independent timing bonus.

A timed-out question contributes zero without leaving the denominator. Other execution/output failures, failed build, integrity violations or a failed mandatory trajectory audit set the overall reward to zero.

The full contract is in the benchmark's task instructions, task documentation, and runtime configuration.
